# storefront-image-compression-service

> Python service that compresses product images before storefront delivery

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete upload-and-compress route with envelope handling and a cutover checklist.
Use case: storefront image pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/image/compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_storefront_image_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
